short_description: Bring source-linked funding comparisons and institution watchlists into your workbook.
description_html:
Build a source-linked public research review inside Excel. Choose funding currencies and exact institution slugs, review returned sources and coverage, then insert a new capture into your workbook.

Seiche provides published funding observations. LiquiLens provides evidence for covered institutions. Analysts can retain source dates, units, gaps and request status beside the values for funding, counterparty and disclosure-review work. Unknown institutions remain uncovered, while missing or withheld numbers remain blank. Download original evidence JSON alongside the workbook for later review.

Public research requires no Financial Evidence account, API key, subscription or additional purchase. A supported Excel host and internet connection are required. Refresh is user initiated. The add-in does not connect to private institution systems, obtain third-party subscription entitlements, or upload existing workbook cells. Source coverage can be delayed, partial or unavailable; retrieval time is not source freshness. Research evidence does not provide regulatory compliance certification, a credit rating, trade execution or credit authorization.
